temporal_schema.profile_scale: normalized input bins; bin sum is not assumed to be lifetime message count

language_scope: observed channel-language labels only; no inference from user lang_code
matching: observed language + normalized-input-bin-sum quantile, one channel reference without replacement
time_scope: hour labels as supplied; no local-night interpretation without timezone confirmation
limitations: Snapshot metadata is not a historical timeline.
Pair similarities are statistically dependent through shared endpoints.
Unselected references are not established benign channels.
Flags are contextual platform annotations, not ground truth for synchronized abuse.
Original descriptions are not exported; extracted URLs/mentions may still contain public identifying information.
